title.zh: Soneium 计划发行生态代币 SONEIUM 并布局链上 IP 经济
title.en: Soneium plans to issue ecosystem token SONEIUM and build on-chain IP economy

current_state.zh: Soneium, Sony's Ethereum Layer 2, plans to launch an ecosystem token SONEIUM and reposition around an on-chain entertainment economy built on tokenized IP, IP vaults, and tokenized IP bonds.
current_state.en: Soneium, Sony's Ethereum Layer 2, plans to launch an ecosystem token SONEIUM and reposition around an on-chain entertainment economy built on tokenized IP, IP vaults, and tokenized IP bonds.

updates.title_zh: Soneium计划推出原生生态代币SONEIUM，并布局IP代币化
updates.title_en: Soneium计划推出原生生态代币SONEIUM，并布局IP代币化
updates.what_changed_zh: Soneium announced it will issue a native ecosystem token, SONEIUM, and build out an on-chain IP economy with a Portal for IP issuance and royalty distribution, IP Vault and IP Bond investment products, and initial partners including Japan's Moriusa character IP and Korean K-pop firm DayOneDream.
